jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Telemundo Orlando, FL
jobs.jd: NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support the daily financial operations for the NBCUniversal Local Television stations serving Orlando, Tampa and Fort Myers. Reporting to the Director of Finance, this role serves as a key finance partner supporting financial planning, analysis, forecasting, reporting, month-end close and operational finance activities. The Senior Financial Analyst will play an integral role in maintaining financial accuracy, supporting budget oversight, and providing timely analysis and insights that drive informed business decisions. This position partners closely with station leadership, FP&A, Controllership, Operations & Technology, AP and Vendor Management teams to support the day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver, is a strong collaborator, demonstrates strong analytical and organizational skills and can effectively balance operational execution with financial analysis. Responsibilities: The primary responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to: Support monthly close activities including journal entries (accruals and reclasses), variance analysis, AP processes, etc. Build, maintain, and analyze financial forecasts, budgets, and estimates. Monitor actual versus budgeted spend, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable insights to finance and operational leadership. Prepare consolidated close reporting packages, variance analyses, overtime and T&E reporting for station management. Support capital planning and reporting, including project pacing, variance analysis, project close-outs, and coordination with operating partners. Serve as the primary finance contact for accounts payable activities including vendor onboarding, vendor maintenance, payment processing, and invoice management. Serve as a day-to-day finance liaison with local operations team including department heads to provide financial support, insights, performance tracking, and decision-making assistance. Support ad-hoc financial analysis, special projects, process improvements, and automation initiatives that enhance reporting efficiency and financial transparency. Maintain compliance with company policies, financial controls, and accounting standards while ensuring accuracy of financial records and supporting documentation. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience. 2+ years of finance experience. Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; strong proficiency with MS Office Suite products. Experience using financial/accounting software and applications (SAP and BPC preferred). Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities across markets. Clear and effective communication skills with ability to present complex data to non-financial stakeholders. Desired Characteristics Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills. Ability to quickly reassess priorities and adapt as required. Demonstrated interpersonal & leadership skills; ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels of the organization. Solid business partnering skills and ability to influence without direct authority. Pioneering spirit – continuously seeking and implementing best practices. Excellent time management skills, with deadline orientation. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Detail oriented and self-starter; can work independently and take initiative in challenging situations. Work experience in Media, Entertainment or Advertising industry desirable. Spanish-language proficiency is preferred. Must be willing and able to work flexible hours as needed to support business requirements, deadlines, and key financial deliverables Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the Orlando office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. Must be willing to travel occasionally for training, meetings, and other business-related purposes (typically no more than 1-2 times per year). As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. jobs.title: Business Analyst, Listing Analytics
jobs.jd: Are you looking for a role that allows you to shape the future of how sellers sell their products globally with Amazon? Do you like working in a startup-like environment with the opportunity to have a significant impact from day one? Do you have an insatiable curiosity about why Amazon global stores operate as they do and how Amazon could optimize its global selling business? If so, then keep reading, as this could be the role for you. Over two million active sellers in twenty-two countries (and growing) list their products for sale on the Amazon stores. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon's ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the earth's largest selection and lowest prices. We are looking for a Business Analyst with a passion for using data to discover and solve real-world problems. You will enjoy working with one of the richest datasets in the world and advanced technology. You will have the ability to see your insights drive the creation of real tools and features for our customers and the thousands of merchants in our Marketplace. The ideal candidate will have passion and experience analyzing data and using that analysis to drive key insights and recommendations. As a Business Analyst, you will also build reports and metrics, drive ad hoc analysis, and communicate insights to key stakeholders. You will not only execute on the required skills but also influence, educate, and drive results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development of policies, processes, and tools to address seller-facing challenges in collaboration with teams across Amazon. This is an opportunity that requires a critical thinker with strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills. At the core of the position is a passion for protecting Amazon's reputation, the customer experience, and customer trust. In this role you will: - Build and maintain recurring metrics and reports. - Complete ad hoc data retrieval and analysis using relational databases, Excel, and other data management systems. - Design and implement reporting solutions enabling stakeholders to manage the business and make effective decisions. - Monitor existing metrics as well as develop and propose new metrics, working with a variety of business stakeholders. - Communicate insights to key stakeholders. - Investigate and solve unstructured and ambiguous problems, including uncovering issues that can influence the product and policy roadmap. Key job responsibilities Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree or equivalent - Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights - Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders - Experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis, formulae, and data visualization - 3+ years of experience in tax, finance, or a related analytical field - 3+ years of experience writing SQL queries and creating business intelligence reports using Quicksight, Tableau or Power BI Preferred qualifications: - Master's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, engineering , analytics, mathematics, statistics or a related technical or quantitative field - Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership - Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting - Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Commercial Risk Management (Strategy & Analytics)
jobs.jd: Senior Business Analyst - Commercial Risk Management (Strategy & Analytics) As a Senior Business Analyst at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You will team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation. This Senior Business Analyst position sits within Commercial Risk Management’s Strategy & Analytics team, which develops and implements risk rating (underwriting) and loss forecasting models across the Commercial Bank. Serving as a key analytical lead for upcoming model builds, this position bridges quantitative modelers and senior business leaders. The candidate will leverage big data tools and visualization platforms (such as Tableau and QuickSight) to evaluate model prototypes through a business lens, using data-driven storytelling to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights that secure stakeholder buy-in. jobs.title: (USA) Data Analyst II
jobs.location: (USA) Upstream Building AR Bentonville Home Office
jobs.jd: Position Summary... Role summary: Join Walmart as a Data Analyst II and apply your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and story telling to support cross-functional teams. You will identify relevant data sources, develop analytical models, and deliver actionable insights that drive informed decision-making. This role requires proficiency in SQL and a strong understanding of business metrics across multiple domains. Collaborating with stakeholders, you will contribute to process improvements and support data quality initiatives while effectively communicating findings to influence business outcomes within a dynamic environment. About the team: The Data Ventures team drives Walmart’s data transformation by developing B2B data products that empower merchants and suppliers to make informed business decisions. Within Data Ventures, the Research & Remediation team investigates data discrepancies and application inconsistencies across merchandising functions, including replenishment, planning, and assortment. By combining business intelligence, root-cause analysis, and impact assessment, the team quantifies business risk, identifies opportunities to improve data quality, and drives solutions that strengthen data integrity and support confident, data-driven decision-making. What you'll do... What you'll do: Analyze business data to support development of actionable insights and recommendations across multiple domains including replenishment, assortment, and merchandising. Identify and source relevant data sets, ensuring data quality and accuracy for analysis and reporting purposes. Leverage your business intelligence to work proactively through the recommendation of data quality rules. Tell the story of decision risk through quantified assessment of impact and qualitative evidence of users Develop agentic solutions to build efficiencies into the investigation of data errors. Support creation of business cases and contribute to decision-making through data-driven insights. What you'll bring: Proficiency in SQL and experience with database technologies including distributed datastores. Strong analytical skills with the ability to apply statistical techniques and exploratory data analysis. Knowledge of business intelligence, merchandise planning, and inventory analysis to support data-driven decisions. Experience in data visualization tools and best practices to effectively communicate insights. Understanding of data quality management, including profiling, cleansing, and validation processes. Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into actionable data solutions. Effective collaboration skills to support cross-functional teams and project delivery. At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.jd: About the Company General Matter is enriching uranium in America. Our goal is to design, build, and operate the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services in the United States. Our mission is to restore America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel—fuel that will power AI, advanced manufacturing, critical industries, and the next generation of nuclear reactors. Ultimately, our work will help power national ambitions and enable a high-energy society. We were incubated by Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by top-tier investors. Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production. We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency. Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable. About This Role General Matter is building the supply chain that will put American-enriched uranium back into production, and we are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to keep our teams supplied with everything they need to build. In this role you will support the full range of supply chain functions—purchasing, vendor management, inventory, and data—working shoulder to shoulder with the engineers and operators building mission-critical hardware. You will own problems end to end, from sourcing a custom component to cleaning up the data that tells us what to buy and when. You will primarily operate for a functional area in the business: Software + I&C, Engineering, or Operations. The analyst role works directly with the engineers and operators to turn requirements into orders, ensure all needs are met, and maintain the organizational supply chain. Responsibilities Support procurement and purchasing of components, raw materials, and services for the departments you support, from requisition through delivery. Manage vendor and supplier relationships day to day—placing and expediting orders, tracking performance, and resolving supply issues before they slow the team down. Own category and vendor management for assigned commodities, including qualifying suppliers and negotiating for price, lead time, and availability. Track inventory, demand, and shortages, and give engineering and manufacturing clear visibility into what is clear-to-build. Maintain accurate master data in our ERP/MRP systems and build the reports and analysis the team needs to make fast, informed decisions. Build reports, dashboards, and cost models that drive decisions to capture and communicate the status of the supply chain program. Partner cross-functionally with engineers, operators, and other supply chain team members to identify problems and drive them to resolution with a bias for action. Basic Qualifications Evidence of exceptional ability (prior projects, portfolio of work, completed products, etc). Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals. Ability to perform trade studies and make clear recommendations using first principles and engineering fundamentals even with partial information. Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, Economics, or a related field. 2–3 years of experience in supply chain, procurement, planning, operations, or a related analytical role (internships included). Preferred Skills and Experience Experience in a fast-paced engineering or highly technical environment, with a resourceful approach to delivering under tight timelines or budget constraints. Hands-on experience with an ERP/MRP system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle). Strong data management and analysis skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel. Exposure to procurement or purchasing processes, including working with suppliers on lead times, MOQs, and price breaks. Experience in a hardware, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or other highly technical environment. SQL, Python, or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) experience. Experience buying to nuclear or other quality standards (e.g., NQA-1, 10 CFR Part 21, ISO 9001, AS9100). Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary. Equal Opportunity Employer General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Compensation and Benefits The base salary range for this role is $100,000–$130,000 annually. Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. Please note that the stated salary range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

jobs.title: Talent AI Operator
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Help make AI-powered recruiting work reliably at scale in an early-stage recruiting technology company. You will oversee autonomous recruiting agents, apply human judgment to candidate conversations, and help shape how people and AI work together throughout the hiring process.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor candidate conversations handled by AI agents, identify errors, and step in when human judgment is needed.

 - Guide senior candidates through complex conversations, objections, compensation discussions, and final hiring stages.

 - Review agent responses, label quality, and provide examples and feedback to improve performance.

 - Audit candidate matches, outreach quality, and conversion metrics across recruiting pipelines.

 - Manage offer discussions and help candidates complete placements successfully.

 - Document effective practices, create operating procedures, and build playbooks for human and AI collaboration.

 - Work with product, engineering, and company leadership to improve recruiting operations and agent behavior.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of experience in recruiting, sourcing, or talent operations at early-stage technology startups.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to evaluate outputs, identify errors, and understand limitations.

 - Experience closing placements and personally managing final-stage candidate conversations, including offer negotiation and objection handling.

 - Experience using recruiting data, such as KPIs, dashboards, A/B tests, or conversion analysis, to guide decisions.

 - Experience labeling outputs or providing feedback to improve AI, machine learning, or agent performance.

 - Comfort collaborating cross-functionally in a startup environment and creating operational documentation.

 - Familiarity with one or more of TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, or Supabase is helpful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Competitive base compensation plus uncapped, performance-based pay tied to placements. Top performers may receive performance-based equity grants after a successful 90-day performance period. Health insurance and visa sponsorship are available.


LOCATION

Hybrid role based in San Francisco, California. An optional shared living and working space is available in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. We are seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist to join our team within the Pharmaceutical Small Molecule Materials Science Computational Sciences group. The successful candidate will work at the interface of materials science, scientific informatics, data science, artificial intelligence/machine learning, and computational tool development . This role will collaborate closely with experimental and computational scientists to develop scientific and automated workflows, data-driven approaches, AI/ML models, scientific applications, and informatics solutions that improve how scientific data are accessed, parsed, analyzed, connected, visualized, and used for decision making. The position offers an opportunity to contribute to an evolving computational-experimental ecosystem connecting scientific data, predictive models, AI, and experimental knowledge . Key Responsibilities Develop and apply data science, AI/ML, and informatics approaches to address Pharmaceutical Materials Science challenges. Build scientific data workflows, analytics, and visualization tools that enable effective use of experimental and computational data. Develop tools and pipelines to extract, transform, standardize, and integrate data from experimental & computational workflows Automate repetitive or manual scientific data-processing and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, reproducibility, and scalability Design, develop, validate, and deploy computational tools and scientific applications supporting research and development workflows. Integrate diverse scientific datasets to enable data-driven insights, predictive modeling, and decision making . Partner with experimental and computational scientists to identify high-value opportunities and translate scientific needs into practical digital solutions. Promote reproducible scientific computing, good software-development practices, and adoption of data and AI capabilities across the organization. Bachelors degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Computational Science, Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering , or a related quantitative/scientific discipline. Strong programming skills, preferably in Python , with demonstrated ability to analyze data and develop computational solutions. Experience with Pharmaceutical data analysis, processing, scientific computing, statistics, machine learning, AI, or scientific informatics . Experience working with chemistry, pharmaceutical, materials-science, or laboratory-generated scientific data . Demonstrated ability to work with complex and heterogenous scientific datasets, including extracting, transforming, integrating, and analyzing structured and/or unstructured data. translate scientific questions into data-driven analyses or computational solutions. Familiarity with modern data-science, scientific computing, and machine-learning tools, libraries and frameworks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate within multidisciplinary scientific teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing scientific software, analytical applications, visualization tools, dashboards, automated workflows, or APIs. Experience with scientific databases, data integration, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, or scientific informatics. Hands-on experience developing or applying machine-learning, deep-learning, generative-AI, or large-language-model approaches . Familiarity with modern software-development practices, including Git/version control, testing, documentation, and reproducible computing . Experience developing interactive scientific applications and user interfaces, including notebook-based environments such as Jupyter/JupyterLab and web-based frameworks or visualization platforms. Experience with cloud computing, high-performance computing, or scalable data-processing environments. Demonstrated ability to take a scientific problem from raw data → structured data → analysis/model → automated workflow or usable computational solution . Position is Monday- Friday 8:00 AM- 5:00PM. Overtime as needed. May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CT are encouraged to apply. Excellent full-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options Life and disability insurance 401(k) with company match Paid vacation and holidays #LI-EB1 Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship Eurofins USA PSS Insourcing Solutions is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Quantitative Trading & Research - Digital - Associate
jobs.jd: The Quantitative Trading & Research team supports the Digital Agenda by building quantitative models and agentic workflows that automate the Access lifecycle and strengthen how Sales and Research teams engage with clients across asset classes. The team applies statistical, machine learning and large language models to client profiles, interactions, coverage efforts and Access activity, including corporate and analyst meetings, roadshows, conferences and events—to improve investor and client targeting, “who to call” recommendations, Access monetization and wallet predictions. Job Summary As an Associate on the team, you will develop and operationalize quantitative models and agentic workflows that help automate the Access lifecycle and improve client engagement. You will work across statistical, machine learning and LLM-based approaches, taking solutions from initial problem definition and data preparation through evaluation, production deployment and ongoing monitoring. You will also partner with Technology, Data and Product teams to integrate your work into tools and workflows used by Sales and Research. Job Responsibilities: Research, develop and validate statistical, machine learning and LLM-based models for client targeting, opportunity prioritization, signal identification and Sales and Research analytics. Build propensity, recommendation and ranking models that identify investors and clients for Access opportunities, with clear rationale and appropriate baselines. Develop investor-to-corporate and investor-to-analyst matching models for Access events using client profiles, interests, holdings, flows, research engagement, participation and feedback. Create wallet and monetization models to estimate client wallet and share-of-wallet, and assess the impact of Access activity, interactions and coverage on revenue and client value. Model client engagement and Sales and Research coverage using interaction, meeting, event and research-consumption data, including time-to-event and attrition signals; build reusable cross-asset client profiles and embeddings. Design agentic workflows to coordinate multi-step Sales, Research and Access tasks, including demand capture, event invitations, scheduling, meeting preparation, summaries, follow-ups and inbound requests. Build workflows that use targeting and matching models to support Access origination and scaling, personalize outreach, coordinate scheduling, capture feedback and update client profiles, with human review where appropriate. Develop agentic coverage workflows that monitor client activity and surface “who to call” recommendations with relevant context and suggested next steps. Create reusable analytical tools and agent capabilities, and design architectures with appropriate planning, retrieval, tool selection, guardrails, human oversight and auditability. Use LLMs to generate personalized client content grounded in source data, with controls for attribution, accuracy, tone and compliance; evaluate models and workflows through benchmarks, backtests, experiments and user feedback. Build reproducible datasets and feature pipelines, maintain production-quality code and monitoring, and partner with Sales, Research, Access, Technology, Data and Product to integrate solutions and measure their impact. Required Qualifications Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience developing modular, testable analytical software for production use. Strong quantitative foundations in probability, statistics, numerical methods, machine learning or related disciplines. Experience designing, implementing and evaluating models, algorithms or analytical techniques against real business problems. Hands-on experience working with complex datasets, including data preparation, feature engineering, validation and reproducible analysis. Ability to design rigorous experiments, interpret results, diagnose failure modes and demonstrate measurable improvements. Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related field. Ability to explain analytical methods, assumptions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Practical judgment and ownership of research delivery, with appropriate handling of confidential data and adherence to established risk and change controls. Preferred Qualifications Experience with derivatives products, client portfolios or positions, Sales analytics, or trade-lifecycle opportunities such as rolls. Experience analyzing financial, client-interaction or time-series datasets to identify actionable signals. Experience developing recommendation or prioritization algorithms, or dynamic analytical client content with traceable sources. Experience applying ML or LLMs to data interpretation, retrieval, content generation or decision support, including evaluation and monitoring. Experience integrating analytical code into applications or AI agents through reusable tools, skills, plugins or MCP interfaces.

jobs.title: Quantitative Trading & Research - Cash Equities - Associate
jobs.jd: The Quantitative Trading & Research team develops quantitative models, algorithms, analytical capabilities and agentic workflows to help Cash Equities Sales teams engage more effectively with clients. By transforming complex client flow and transaction data, including trades, orders, axes and IOIs, into actionable signals, client-targeting insights, “who to call” recommendations, dynamic client content, trade ideas and post-trade opportunities, the team supports both inbound and outbound client workflows Job Summary As an Associate in the Quantitative Trading & Research team, you will develop quantitative models, algorithms, analytical capabilities and agentic workflows that improve how Cash Equities Sales teams engage with clients. You will transform complex data, including client flow and transactional data such as trades, orders, axes and IOIs, into relevant signals, client targeting and "who to call" recommendations, LLM-generated dynamic client content, trade ideas and post-trade opportunities, supporting inbound and outbound client workflows. You will own the research lifecycle from problem framing and data preparation through methodology, evaluation, production implementation and monitoring, partnering with Technology, Data and Product on integration. You will use statistical methods, ML, LLMs and AI agents where they add value. Job Responsibilities Research, develop and validate models and algorithms for data processing, signal identification, client targeting, opportunity prioritization and Sales analytics. Construct reproducible research datasets and develop methods for extracting, enriching and interpreting structured and unstructured data, including Cash Equities flow and transactional data (executions, orders, axes, IOIs, blocks). Analyze client trading behavior, including flow patterns, sector and stock preferences, position changes, liquidity needs and trading style, to identify which clients to target, with which ideas, and when. Develop "who to call" recommendation models that rank clients for Sales coverage by combining flow signals, axes and liquidity, trade ideas and market events, with a clear rationale for each recommendation. Build reusable executable analytical capabilities, including tools, skills and plugins, that encode research methods for use in Sales applications and AI-assisted workflows. Design, build and evaluate agentic workflows that orchestrate these tools, data services and models to automate multi-step Sales tasks, such as client pre-call briefings, flow summaries, idea-to-client matching and inbound request handling, with appropriate guardrails, human-in-the-loop review and auditability. Develop dynamic, data-derived client content grounded in analytical insights, with clear source attribution and supporting rationale, for outreach and responses to inbound requests. Use LLMs to generate personalized client content, such as talking points, flow commentary, trade idea summaries and outreach drafts, grounded in underlying data through retrieval, with controls for factual accuracy, hallucination, tone and compliance. Develop algorithms to generate trade ideas and identify post-trade opportunities using client positions, historical flow, objectives, product characteristics and market conditions, and match ideas, axes and liquidity to the most relevant clients. Design experiments and evaluation benchmarks, compare approaches against baselines, and use error analysis and Sales feedback to improve analytical quality and business impact, including the reliability, accuracy and usefulness of agent and LLM outputs, recommendation uptake and content quality. Implement and maintain production-quality analytical code, with testing, reproducibility, explainability and monitoring of model, agent and output performance. Required Qualifications Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience developing modular, testable analytical software for production use. Strong quantitative foundations in probability, statistics, numerical methods, machine learning or related disciplines. Experience designing, implementing and evaluating models, algorithms or analytical techniques against real business problems. Hands-on experience working with complex datasets, including large-scale transactional or time-series data, data preparation, feature engineering, validation and reproducible analysis. Ability to design rigorous experiments, interpret results, diagnose failure modes and demonstrate measurable improvements. Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related field. Ability to explain analytical methods, assumptions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Practical judgment and ownership of research delivery, with appropriate handling of confidential data and adherence to established risk and change controls. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Cash Equities, including client flow, execution data, axes/IOIs, block trading or market microstructure. Experience with client portfolios or positions, Sales analytics, or trade-lifecycle opportunities. Experience analyzing financial or time-series datasets to identify actionable signals. Experience developing "who to call", client targeting, recommendation or prioritization algorithms, or dynamic analytical client content with traceable sources. Experience applying ML or LLMs to data interpretation, retrieval, content generation or decision support, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, evaluation and monitoring. Experience designing and evaluating agentic workflows (e.g. tool-calling agents, multi-step orchestration, planning and retrieval), including guardrails, evaluation harnesses and observability. Experience integrating analytical code into applications or AI agents through reusable tools, skills, plugins or MCP interfaces.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


JOB SUMMARY

Help us understand how PostHog grows, what that growth costs, and what we should plan for next. Working directly with our Finance team, you’ll own the day-to-day consolidated financial model, expense planning, and board reporting, with their guidance. You’ll explain differences between actual results and plans, partner with team leads on hiring and spending decisions, and ask thoughtful questions that challenge our assumptions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Corporate planning and consolidation
   
   - Maintain the integrated three-statement forecast: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow. Keep actuals, assumptions, and scenarios consistent and easy to follow.
   
   - Own the quarterly board pack and investor reporting. Report costs versus plan each month and explain what changed. Support fundraising analysis when needed.

 - Operating expenses and business partnering
   
   - Work with team leads to track hiring and vendor spending. Update the forecast each month and explain changes.
   
   - Set up monthly planning reviews so team leads can see their spending outlook and discuss changes.

 - Revenue and commercial analysis
   
   - Support Mine's revenue modeling, check inputs and calculations, document assumptions, and explain performance versus plan.
   
   - Run the weekly revenue update when Mine is out.

 - Example public issues/projects:
   The models and board materials are internal. These links provide public context for example projects.
   
   - Build a consolidated forecast and monthly reporting pack. Public context: Finance team https://posthog.com/teams/finance
   
   - Build a headcount and vendor-spend forecast that shows what changed each month and which decisions need review. Public context: Spending money https://posthog.com/handbook/people/spending-money
   
   - Build an infrastructure cost forecast and show how cost per product changes as usage grows. Public context: Pricing and usage-based products https://posthog.com/pricing




WHAT YOU WON'T BE DOING

❌ Sales Ops execution (deal desk, contracts, credits/refunds, commission calculations, policy implementation)

❌ Accounting close, revenue recognition, collections, and the GL

❌ Billing-system engineering or ownership of the data platform. The analyst uses and checks these teams' outputs for planning.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Build and debug an integrated three-statement model in Excel or Google Sheets. Make assumptions explicit, add checks, and test scenarios.

 - Turn an unclear business question into a model. Separate facts from assumptions and explain which inputs drive the answer.

 - Reconcile model outputs to source data and investigate discrepancies. Keep forecasts and reporting accurate and up to date.

 - Explain why results differ from plan, get useful inputs from team leads, and follow up on missing information.

 - Ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and want to learn how a software business works.

 - AI is part of how you work. You use tools to build and check models, write SQL, and automate reporting, and you can show us examples of this.

 - Work in a small team where processes are still being built.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you - we're happy to accommodate! 

#LI-DNI

The Analyst I in the Enterprise Analytics team will partner with stakeholders to drive customer acquisition, analyze offer performance, identify industry trends, segment Caesars’ customer database, perform ad-hoc analysis, and create standardized reporting in support of the operations within Caesars Entertainment. This includes analyzing labor trends, staffing levels, and workforce performance to support labor planning, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. Conduct objective, rigorous analytics to help the business improve profitability, operational processes, and customer service – e.g., identification and evaluation of revenue growth opportunities, resource optimization, optimal investment mix, competitive market dynamics, customer behavior, and pricing optimization Distill vast datasets into actionable insights and recommendations that guide decisions and strategies. Contribute to the development of presentation materials and assist in presenting findings to senior management concisely in verbal and written formats Play an active role in the development, roll-out, and post-launch evaluation of strategic projects Develop and support reporting for operating departments to provide senior leaders visibility into trends and business performance drivers Use technology (e.g., SQL, R, Tableau, Google BigQuery, Python) to develop analytics and reporting tools Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college Experience querying, analyzing, and visualizing large data sets Strength in critical thinking, problem solving, and written and verbal communication. Comfort in articulating complex information and analyses to a variety of audiences Intellectual curiosity and willingness to quickly learn relevant database applications and software, as well as industry-specific terminology and dynamics ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Bachelor’s Degree from a top-tier program in one of the following areas: Finance, Marketing, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics/Statistics, Hotel Management, Business, or Data Science Demonstrated interest in a career in data- and analytics-driven business Desire to understand a broad range of operations within the casino and hospitality industry Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines while consistently delivering accurate and high-quality work Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment Ability to uphold and demonstrate the highest level of integrity Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: SQL, R, VBA, SAS, Python, and/or experience in working with Google BigQuery. Some experience in working with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Hyperion experience a plus

jobs.title: Logistics TMS Analyst
jobs.location: USA - Corona, CA; USA - Rogers, AR
jobs.jd: About Monster Energy: Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us. A Day in the Life: In the position of Analyst, Logistics TMS, you will be responsible for day to day logistic activities, tracking shipments, ensuring documentation and funds are provided for customs clearance. Analyze transportation data to identify trends and inefficiencies. The Impact You'll Make: Analyze transportation data to identify trends and inefficiencies. Ensure data being analyzed and presented is accurate. Manage freight lane data within Transportation Management Systems (TMS) system and lead process for setting up new lanes in TMS as needed. Use knowledge and skills to find solutions to minimize disruptions. Interact with various internal department personnel, country managers, external customers and freight facilitators to ensure data integrity, accuracy and address customer issues. Manage daily, weekly, monthly, annual transportation reporting for data analysis. Analyze data and design new deployment models as needed and based on data analysis, work with management to optimize carrier selection, lanes, and call out data that does not align with current Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s). Schedule container bookings to fulfill customer finished goods orders and/or production planning of raw material needs, as well as coordinating the shipment of Premium and Apparel commodities. Maintain container log to track shipments accurately so that trigger dates for inventory movement and billing are reported accurately. Provide necessary information and documentation to warehouses and freight forwarders to effectively coordinate the timely loading of shipments and prepare necessary shipping documents or work with customer service personnel to ensure that all customs clearance requirements are met. Coordinate prepayment of customs clearance fees and assist in procuring bids on shipping lanes. Effectively communicate with various internal departments to ensure product availability, adherence to quality control guidelines and packaging standards and ensure that required shipping documents are on file and maintained for the specified audit requirement period. Who You Are: Prefer a bachelor's degree in the field of Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or related field Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in transportation, warehouse, or inventory management Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in creating and presenting high level reports of data analysis. Computer Skills Desired: Proficient in Microsoft Office suite. Intermediate SQL experience. Experience with Business Intelligence Software such as Power BI & Tableau. Other experience with BI software a plus. SAP experience preferred. Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Knowledge of transportation regulations and compliance.Familiarity with lean management and continuous improvement methodologies. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, experience, and work location. jobs.title: Contract Data Scientist (40 hrs/wk)
jobs.jd: Layer Health was founded in 2023 by leading machine learning researchers from MIT and Harvard Medical School. We are building an AI layer that can accurately and scalably synthesize information from medical records, with the mission to reduce friction everywhere in healthcare. Our LLM-powered platform is solving chart review once and for all, across use cases. For health systems, our first product dramatically accelerates clinical registry abstraction in areas ranging from surgery and cardiology, to oncology. Our long term vision is for our AI layer to safely transform patient care and minimize unnecessary heartbreak. Layer Health’s diverse founding team brings expertise across machine learning, UI/UX, large language models, and medicine. Here’s a collection of articles about our product, mission, recent funding round, etc. Job Description You will work with the Layer Health ML team applying our existing ML workflow to tailor models for a specific clinical use case. You will design, build, evaluate, and iterate on these models — combining strong data science fundamentals with modern LLM techniques to deliver high-accuracy, production-ready solutions across new clinical domains. This is a high-velocity, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys diving deep into error modes, making targeted improvements, and closing the loop between model performance and real-world impact. This contract will require full-time hours. What you’ll do: Own end-to-end development of models for specific use cases: Build and iterate using our ML/LLM-powered workflows for new clinical areas, from initial prototyping through production refinement. Conduct evaluation & error analysis: Own rigorous evaluation of model performance; perform deep error analysis to identify systematic failure modes and drive targeted improvements. Ship frequent, high-quality updates to models based on data, feedback, and observed edge cases. Leverage LLM application & tooling: Apply modern LLM techniques (prompting strategies, structured outputs, tool use, eval frameworks) to improve accuracy and robustness. Support analytics & metrics: Contribute to metrics, reporting, and internal dashboards that track model performance and downstream impact. We look for: Good data science fundamentals , including knowledge of best practices for evaluating model performance and error analysis. (A proven track record of successful projects in healthcare or clinical applications is a bonus, but not required.) Familiarity with modern applied LLM techniques and their practical implementations, for example e.g. standard prompting techniques, LLM frameworks, structured output usage, etc. (any experience using these techniques is a bonus). Solid programming skills in Python. A strong technical communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Proactive mindset to identify and solve problems, continuously improving our data science capabilities. An excited and adaptable team player who wants to disrupt the healthcare industry with AI/ML, alongside an awesome team. Willingness to be hybrid with our team in either our Boston or NYC office 3 days per week. Expected compensation range for this role is $40 - $70/hour. Compensation is dependent on experience, overall fit to our role, and candidate location. Expected compensation ranges for this role may change over time. If your compensation requirement is greater than our posted salary ranges, please still consider applying to our role. We will make a determination as to whether an exception can be made. If you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways. We welcome diverse perspectives, rigorous thinking, and fearlessness in challenging the status quo. Join us and help us transform healthcare with AI. Layer Health is committed to foster an environment of inclusion that is free from discrimination. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer where employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Dispute Risk
jobs.jd: About the role We’re hiring a data-driven Risk Analyst with strong analytical skills and an investigative mindset. You’ll help reduce fraud losses, improve risk processes, and protect a positive member experience. Alongside your core analytics work, you will also be investigating selected fraud and dispute cases-bringing together case evidence, transaction and account data, and risk signals to support clear, well-documented outcomes. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, Operational and member Experience partners. The role is a good fit for someone who can move between portfolio-level questions and detailed case review, conduct ground level investigation and data queries , communicate what the evidence supports, and turn findings into better risk decisions and processes. In this role, you can expect to Analyze fraud and loss trends (25%) - Explore data proactively and in response to loss events to identify drivers, quantify opportunities, and recommend ways to reduce losses while minimizing member friction. Investigate fraud and dispute cases (30%) - Review assigned cases from intake through resolution or escalation. Bring together relevant member statements, transaction and account history, merchant evidence where applicable, and risk signals. Assess evidence quality and consistency; document what is supported, what remains uncertain, and the recommended next step in accordance with established policies and decision authority. Understand agent SOPs and get familiar with using agent tools with the goal to improve AHT and decision accuracy. Improve processes and automation (20%) - Identify and apply AI and automation opportunities across dispute and fraud workflows to reduce repetitive manual work, improve consistency, and accelerate analysis. Partner with relevant teams to test solutions, validate outputs, and ensure appropriate human review and controls before implementation. Build reporting and monitor performance (10%) - Develop and maintain actionable dashboards and reports that track risk performance against loss and member-experience metrics. Collaborate on ad hoc needs (15%) - Partner with internal stakeholders to answer time-sensitive questions and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. To thrive in this role, you have 2+ years of analytical experience, preferably in financial services or fintech. 2+ years of experience in Fraud, Compliance, Risk, Investigations, or a related field; relevant case-review or dispute experience is a plus. Excellent SQL and advanced google sheets skills; experience with Python is preferred. Familiarity with payment processing fundamentals and an interest in fraud typologies, risk trends, or risk strategy. Strong critical thinking and attention to detail; you can synthesize information across multiple sources and explain how it supports a conclusion. Clear written communication and sound documentation habits, especially when handling sensitive, member-impacting cases. Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage analytical work and assigned investigations in a fast-paced environment. Proficient using AI-assisted tools and automation to improve productivity, while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information. A growth mindset, willingness to learn new tools and processes, and a passion for Chime’s mission. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitatively rigorous discipline such as engineering, statistics, mathematics, or economics is preferred. #LI-Onsite #LI-BE1 Below is the base salary offered for this role and level of experience. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

 

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

 

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).



Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.



Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 



What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants. 



We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

jobs.jd:
About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

 

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

 

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

 

Why We’re Hiring

Our Business Operations & Analytics  team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

 

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

 

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 

 

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.
