jobs.title: Customer Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT US

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Fieldguide is looking for a Customer Data Operations Analyst to help build and operationalize the data foundation that connects how customers use Fieldguide with how we measure, understand, and communicate the value they receive from the platform.

This role will sit at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, Data Science, and GTM Operations, translating real-world customer needs into scalable data models, trusted reporting, and actionable insights. The role will combine strong SQL and analytics capabilities with hands-on data modeling and reporting, ensuring customer data is accurate, accessible, and built to scale.

While this role will participate in select customer meetings, QBRs, and onsite engagements to understand reporting requirements firsthand, the majority of the role will be hands-on—developing and customizing reports, querying and validating data, building and maintaining data models, and addressing gaps in the underlying data infrastructure. You will then partner with Product and Data Science to ensure the right information is captured, structured, validated, and surfaced consistently.

The goal is to create a trusted customer data foundation that enables Fieldguide and its customers to answer critical questions around product adoption, engagement, efficiency, time savings, ROI, value realization, and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN


CUSTOMER DATA REPORTING & INSIGHTS

 - Own the development and customization of customer-facing reports and dashboards, translating customer requirements into accurate and actionable reporting.

 - Use SQL and existing data infrastructure to investigate customer questions, validate reported metrics, and resolve discrepancies.

 - Build scalable reporting solutions that can be reused across customers, service lines, and engagement types.

 - Partner with Customer Success to support data-driven QBRs, executive business reviews, renewals, and value realization conversations.

 - Identify where customer-specific reporting requests reveal broader gaps in Fieldguide's underlying data models or product reporting capabilities.

 - Work with Product and Data Science to move frequently requested reporting from manual/custom analysis toward standardized and productized capabilities


DATA MODELING & ANALYTICS

 - Develop and maintain scalable data models that support customer reporting, QBRs, value realization, and product analytics.

 - Write advanced SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze customer and product data across multiple data sources.

 - Build and maintain data models and transformations to create reliable, reusable downstream datasets.

 - Identify gaps in existing data models and address legacy data quality, modeling, and structural issues that impact reporting accuracy.

 - Translate recurring one-off reporting requirements into standardized, scalable data models and reporting infrastructure.

 - Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering to determine when customer reporting requirements should be addressed through analytics, data modeling, upstream product instrumentation, or broader infrastructure changes.

 - Establish reusable datasets and semantic definitions that enable consistent reporting across customers rather than recreating logic for individual accounts.

 - Reduce manual and one-off reporting by identifying opportunities for automation and standardized reporting.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means Fieldguide has a trusted, scalable customer data foundation rather than relying on fragmented or one-off analysis.

 - Customer-facing metrics have clear definitions, sources, methodologies, and owners.

 - Customer teams can confidently use data in QBRs and executive conversations.

 - Product usage and customer outcomes can be connected to measurable value.

 - Data discrepancies are identified and addressed at their source.

 - Customer feedback systematically informs Product and Data priorities.

 - Recurring customer data requests become standardized and automated where possible.

 - Fieldguide can increasingly demonstrate defensible ROI and value realization.

 - Customer reporting becomes consistent across QBRs, renewals, and strategic engagements.

 - Product and Data teams have a clear understanding of the information customers need from Fieldguide.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Operations, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, or a related technical data role.

 - Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting complex datasets.

 - Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, data transformations, metric definitions, and analytics architecture.

 - Strong understanding of data quality, validation, governance, and operational workflows.

 - Ability to translate business and customer questions into structured data requirements.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large or complex datasets.

 - Experience creating dashboards, reports, and executive-level data narratives.

 - Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company.

 - Hands-on experience with dbt, including building, maintaining, testing, and documenting scalable data models.

 - Experience supporting Customer Success, QBRs, value realization, or customer analytics.

 - Familiarity with audit, advisory, accounting, or professional services workflows.

 - Experience working with product telemetry and customer usage data.

 - Experience partnering directly with Data Science or Analytics Engineering teams.



More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Preparedness
jobs.jd:
About the Team

The Preparedness team is an important part of the Safety Systems https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems org at OpenAI, and is guided by OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework https://openai.com/index/updating-our-preparedness-framework/.

Frontier AI models have the potential to benefit all of humanity, but also pose increasingly severe risks. To ensure that AI promotes positive change, the Preparedness team helps us prepare for the development of increasingly capable frontier AI models. This team is tasked with identifying, tracking, and preparing for catastrophic risks related to frontier AI models.

The mission of the Preparedness team is to:

 1. Closely monitor and predict the evolving capabilities of frontier AI systems, with an eye towards misuse risks whose impact could be catastrophic to our society

 2. Ensure we have concrete procedures, infrastructure and partnerships to mitigate these risks and to safely handle the development of powerful AI systems

Preparedness tightly connects capability assessment, evaluations, and internal red teaming, and mitigations for frontier models, as well as overall coordination on AGI preparedness. This is fast paced, exciting work that has far reaching importance for the company and for society.

 

About the Role

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help build, evaluate, and continuously improve mitigations that prevent extreme harms from AI systems. This role is for an experienced, highly autonomous individual contributor who can take ambiguous problem statements, structure rigorous analyses, and translate findings into actionable product and policy changes.

This position goes beyond “running evals.” You’ll help create mitigation intelligence and monitoring systems that enable OpenAI to detect issues early, measure effectiveness over time, and reduce both over-blocking (unnecessary friction) and under-blocking (missed harm).





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate and improve mitigation systems, including classifiers and detection pipelines across domains (e.g., biosecurity, cybersecurity, and emerging risk areas).

 - Diagnose false positives and false negatives with deep error analysis, root cause investigation, and clear recommendations for mitigation adjustments.

 - Build monitoring and measurement frameworks to track mitigation effectiveness over time and across user segments and use cases.

 - Identify trends in over-blocking vs. under-blocking, quantify customer impact, and propose prioritized interventions.

 - Develop insights from customer feedback, complaints, and usage patterns to detect shifts in adversarial behavior and system failure modes.

 - Expand risk monitoring into new areas, including cybersecurity threats and model loss-of-control or sabotage scenarios, in partnership with domain experts.

 - Communicate results to technical and executive stakeholders with crisp narratives, decision-ready metrics, and clear tradeoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you are:

 - An autonomous operator: you can take a problem statement and independently structure the analysis end-to-end.

 - Strong at executive-ready communication: concise, clear, and outcome-oriented.

 - Skilled in turning analysis into productable changes: you’re comfortable influencing across functions to drive mitigation improvements.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience in data science or applied analytics in high-stakes domains (e.g., security, trust & safety, abuse prevention, fraud, platform integrity, or reliability).

 - Strong foundations in experimentation, causal thinking, and/or observational inference; ability to design robust measurement under imperfect data.

 - Fluency in SQL and Python (or equivalent) for analysis, modeling, and building monitoring workflows.

 - Experience building metrics, dashboards, and operational monitoring that meaningfully changes outcomes (not just reporting).

 - Track record of driving cross-functional impact with engineering, product, and research partners.

 - Cybersecurity data science experience (strong preference), including exposure to threat modeling, adversarial dynamics, abuse patterns, or security telemetry.

 - Experience with classifier evaluation, calibration, thresholding, and error analysis at scale.
   Familiarity with detection systems in adversarial settings (e.g., evasion, distribution shift, feedback loops).

 - Trust & Safety experience is helpful, but not required.

 - Genuine interest in AI safety, alignment, and catastrophic risk prevention.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Analyst, Partner Strategy
jobs.jd:
Cambio is a software platform that drives world-class real estate decarbonization. We help commercial real estate owners and tenants bring their real estate portfolios to net-zero using a machine learning-driven, end-to-end real estate sustainability platform. Our mission is to take the real estate industry into the climate action era.

As a Partner Strategy Analyst at Cambio, you will play a pivotal role in owning end-to-end data quality assurance for some of the world’s leading institutions who have chosen Cambio to manage their carbon accounting, benchmarking, reporting, and decarbonization efforts — including helping clients understand and act on building performance standards (BEPS) and other regulatory requirements. If you enjoy tackling quantitative problems, have a passion for climate-related work, and are excited about the idea of working at a fast-paced team at the forefront of climate, AI and real estate technology, this role is for you!



Key Responsibilities

 - Support onboarding for large institutional clients, assessing existing data sources and creating tailored onboarding plans.

 - Work with asset and property management teams to automate data collection and ensure smooth data ingestion.

 - Oversee end-to-end data quality assurance, transforming raw data into standardized, accurate inputs for Cambio’s platform and resolving issues with product and engineering teams.

 - Own all quantitative analytics delivered to customers, ensuring complete accuracy and high-quality outputs.

 - Build and maintain building-level energy, water, and carbon benchmarks (e.g., ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager) that give clients a clear, defensible view of asset performance relative to peers and regulatory thresholds.

 - Track jurisdiction-specific building benchmarking and Building Performance Standards (BEPS) requirements — such as NYC Local Law 97, DC BEPS, and BERDO — monitoring compliance deadlines and fine exposure, and translating pathway options into clear guidance for property and asset management teams.

 - Support enterprise sustainability reporting across frameworks like GRESB, TCFD, and CDP, ensuring benchmarking and compliance data flow accurately into every submission.

 - Manage building documentation collection and coordinate with building science teams to ensure successful analysis delivery.

 - Coordinate communication workflows and follow-ups for major customer accounts to ensure strong customer success.

Impact

With this role, you’ll have the opportunity to achieve the following accomplishments:

 1. Executed the measurement of real estate energy, water, waste, and carbon data across large asset portfolios, driving the identification of energy savings through Cambio’s decarbonization platform.

 2. Ensured the accuracy of carbon emissions data and developed new analytical methods to power the world’s leading AI-based retrofit analytics and real estate sustainability data platform.

 3. Collaborated with real estate owner customers to identify and remedy data inaccuracies, saving customers 100+ hours of time across asset & portfolio management teams and reducing data gaps by up to 25%.

 4. Built out jurisdiction-specific Building Performance Standards compliance pathways across client portfolios, giving an owners and property managers a single source of truth for benchmarking, fine exposure, and reporting deadlines across multiple regulatory jurisdictions.

Qualifications

 - Strong quantitative background: 2+ years of experience in a consulting, data analytics, accounting, or finance.

 - Data-obsessed: You are meticulous and thrive when surrounded by numbers. You are willing to roll up your sleeves to work with unstructured and inconsistent data using Excel. Experience with SQL or computer programming a bonus, but not required

 - Creative problem-solving: To you, an Excel model is an exciting puzzle to solve. You have the ability to think outside the box when addressing challenges

 - Strong communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You are able to make complex problems seem simple and communicate these with multiple parties in dynamic, fast-moving environments

 - Collaborative team player: You prioritize the team's success and foster collaboration

 - Experience working with carbon or building data: Experience handling energy, carbon, or real estate data is a bonus, but not required

 - Understanding of building benchmarking & performance standards: Familiarity with energy/water benchmarking programs (e.g., ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager) and Building Performance Standards (BEPS) regulations such as NYC Local Law 97, DC BEPS, or BERDO — or a strong eagerness to build that expertise — is a significant plus
   
   

Logistics:

 - Work Authorization: Authorization to work in the United States or Canada is required.

 - Location: This is a hybrid role requiring 2–3 days of in-person collaboration per week.
   
    

If you thrive on creating well-crafted products and systems that have a disproportionate impact on the real estate industry’s path to net zero, we invite you to join our team. Apply now to embark on this journey with us.

jobs.title: Warranty Analyst
jobs.jd: MSX has been a trusted partner to leading vehicle manufacturers, their retailers, and mobility organizations globally for more than 30 years. Our unwavering commitment is to help our clients transform their businesses and effectively manage operations in the areas of: Sales Performance; Repair Optimization and Compliance; Parts and Accessories Sales Performance; and Consumer Engagement. With our global teams, industry expertise, and the power of technology, we design and deliver tailored, sustainable, and innovative solutions and services that help our clients optimize their operations and captivate their customers. MSX International’s warranty support program provides analytical and technical support to the client to help monitor warranty performance, identify emerging vehicle concerns, and support informed decisions on repair quality and warranty costs. Based on-site at the client headquarters in Fountain Valley, California, the program brings together warranty analysis, vehicle repair information, and cross-functional collaboration to support product quality and customer satisfaction. The Warranty Analyst contributes by investigating warranty and goodwill claims, analyzing expense and repair trends, and reviewing vehicle buyback cases to identify and document the defective causal parts or conditions associated with repurchase. Position Summary Do you enjoy connecting the dots between vehicle repair records, warranty data, and the technical issues behind them? Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to turn complex information into actionable findings? At MSX International, we’re looking for a Warranty Analyst to support warranty group through data analysis, technical case review, and accurate documentation. You’ll evaluate warranty and goodwill performance, investigate unusual claim patterns, and collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal stakeholders to identify areas requiring further review. You’ll also support vehicle buyback analysis by reviewing repair histories and related records to identify and document the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions that led to vehicle repurchase under applicable lemon laws. This on-site, hourly role offers direct collaboration with warranty, quality, and engineering teams at the headquarters, providing exposure to automotive operations and opportunities for professional development. As a member of the warranty support team, you’ll: Analyze warranty expenses and prepare monthly comparisons against forecasts, prior-month results, and prior-year performance. Evaluate warranty performance by model and model year, including total costs, units in operation, failure rates, and cost per claim. Review powertrain warranty expenses, including coverage under HMA’s 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. Analyze quarterly cost-per-unit trends by month in service, including failure rates, claim costs, and labor operation codes across warranty, goodwill, and campaign repairs. Identify significant cost variances, emerging concerns, and unusual claim patterns; communicate findings and recommend further investigation. Monitor goodwill expenses, support forecasting, and identify campaign-related costs and dealers with high expenses and low customer satisfaction results. Analyze warranty repair data alongside technician training records to identify potential relationships between training gaps and repeat repairs. Review dealer use of labor operation codes and warranty repairs, coordinating with Regional Warranty Managers when excessive or unusual activity requires investigation. Conduct repair-sequence and repair-narrative analyses to assess dealer repair efficiency and potential effects on vehicle quality. Review vehicle buyback repair records, service orders, and customer communications to identify the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions associated with repurchase. Collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal departments to clarify technical findings and accurately document buyback conclusions. Enter and maintain warranty, claim, and buyback findings in designated internal systems. Prepare reports, presentations, and ad hoc analyses for management. Participate in training and product-information exchanges; travel, including overnight stays, may be required for up to four weeks annually. Support occasional vehicle testing, service coordination, and other related assignments as directed. Technical Expertise Strong understanding of automotive repair procedures, diagnostic methods, and vehicle systems. Ability to interpret repair orders, warranty claims, service histories, and technical documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to analyze warranty costs, failure rates, claim trends, and forecast variances. Strong data-entry accuracy and documentation practices. Desired Skills Strong analytical, mathematical, and root-cause investigation skills. Exceptional attention to detail when reviewing technical records and documenting findings. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong organization, prioritization, multitasking, and follow-up skills. Ability to collaborate with client personnel, dealership staff, engineers, and warranty teams. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a plus. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Experience in automotive repair and product quality. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and develop clear findings and recommendations. Strong computer proficiency, including database querying and Microsoft Office applications. Ability to manage multiple assignments while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Four-year degree in engineering. Dealership fixed operations and warranty experience. At MSX International, you’ll apply your automotive knowledge and analytical skills to meaningful warranty and product quality challenges. Working on-site at the headquarters provides opportunities to collaborate with warranty, quality, and engineering professionals while broadening your understanding of manufacturer operations. If you’re ready to turn technical records and warranty data into actionable insights, we want to hear from you. About the Role:

Crusoe is looking for a Financial Analyst, Real Estate, Land & Leases to support the financial due diligence, deal analysis, and lifecycle tracking of land and real estate transactions underpinning Crusoe’s data center campuses. This role works closely with the Director of Real Estate Finance and cross-functional partners to build the models, materials, and tracking tools that keep land and lease decisions moving.



This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role suited to someone early in their finance career who wants exposure to real estate, project finance, and infrastructure deal-making, in a company where land and power access are often the binding constraint on how fast infrastructure gets built. This is a full-time, exempt position.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Due Diligence Support — Support financial due diligence on prospective land acquisitions, ground leases, and site control agreements, helping evaluate cost basis, tax implications, and site-level economics; assist in gathering and organizing information from Legal, Real Estate, and Power teams on title, easements, zoning, utility access, and environmental factors.

 - Site-Level Financial Modeling — Build and maintain site-level financial models (acquisition cost, ground lease economics, property tax, incentive/abatement value) to support go/no-go TCO investment decisions.

 - Commercial Structure Support — Assist in analyzing land purchase agreements, ground leases, option agreements, and related real estate instruments to help ensure terms align with financing strategy; prepare supporting analysis on how land ownership vs. lease structures affect debt sizing and financeability, working alongside Capital Markets/Project Finance teams.

 - Incentives & Abatements — Help compile materials for negotiating economic development incentives, tax abatements, and PILOT agreements with local and state governments.

 - Lifecycle & Asset Management — Maintain financial tracking of land/real estate assets across their lifecycle, from acquisition through construction and operations; build and update a portfolio-level view of land and lease obligations (payment schedules, escalators, renewal options, purchase options) for forecasts and reporting.

 - Accounting Support — Support Accounting on proper treatment of land, leases (ASC 842), and related capital costs.

jobs.title: Analyst, Applied Validations
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production.



Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale.



We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Simile, accuracy is the product. Enterprise buyers want proof that Simile matches what their customers actually say and do, and as an Applied Validations Analyst, you will own that proof. You'll design and run customer validations and backtests that compare Simile's simulated results against real-world ground truth, then diagnose gaps, explain what the evidence supports, and identify opportunities to improve performance.



You'll work alongside Solutions Consultants and Deployments, and be deeply embedded with our Modeling, Evals, and Data teams. You'll turn one-off studies into repeatable, scalable workflows that build customer trust in a new category of AI. You'll identify patterns across customer validations and work with Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product to turn those findings into improvements, and test whether those improvements address the gaps.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys writing code, investigating data, and learning new methods while working at the pace of customer engagements.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Study Scoping: Scope validation and backtest studies with Solutions Consultants, Deployments, and customers. Pick the right use case, agree on metrics and success criteria up front, and flag studies that won't produce a meaningful comparison. Guide teams on which validation approaches are appropriate given current model and product capabilities.

 - Simulation & Comparison: Run simulations and compare them against human ground truth using industry standard evaluation metrics.

 - Diagnosing Misses: Break down gaps by segment and population to determine drivers of differences around methodology, model, data, or sampling. Identify recurring patterns across validations to distinguish isolated gaps from systematic gaps. 

 - Closing the Loop: Translate validation gaps into reproducible examples and concrete recommendations for Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product. Partner with these teams on follow-up experiments, evaluation coverage, and data, and retest whether changes address the gaps.

 - Reusable Tooling: Build Python pipelines, API-driven experiments, and LLM skills for repeatable validation loops. .

 - Customer Readouts: Write clear readouts showing where the model is strongly aligned and where it is more directional, and present them to technical and business stakeholders.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS


MUST HAVES

 - Statistics & Analytical Judgment: A solid foundation in statistics, including sampling, variability, correlation, and bias. You can question data quality, recognize misleading comparisons, investigate differences across populations and segments, and assess whether conclusions are supported by the evidence.

 - Learning & Iteration: Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar methods and tools quickly, investigate unexpected results, and improve an approach through structured experimentation. You are motivated to build expertise in customer validations and backtesting.

 - Technical & AI-Native Workflow: Ability to use Python and APIs to analyze data and run reproducible experiments, including using Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents to accelerate the work. You can review and validate the outputs these tools produce.

 - Communication & Commercial Judgment: You can turn analysis into a clear narrative, explain results and limitations to technical and business audiences, and connect findings to customer decisions and priorities.

 - Collaboration & Follow-Through: You can translate findings into actionable recommendations, work with Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product teams to address gaps, and document lessons that help others move faster.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Validation & Model Improvement: Experience running backtests and evaluating predictive models.

 - Evaluation Methods: Familiarity with holdout datasets, data leakage, and testing whether improvements generalize to unseen examples.

 - Human Study & Measurement Methods: Familiarity with survey & human study design, panel sampling, distributional comparisons such as TVD, choice-based methods, or differences between stated intent and observed behavior.

 - Research Background: Experience in behavioral research, market research, consumer insights, survey science, or a research-agency analytics team.

 - Survey Platforms: Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms and panel providers.

 - Customer-Facing Technical Work: Experience in applied data science, technical consulting, or presenting analytical findings to customers.
   
   

Compensation & Benefits

At Simile, we provide competitive compensation packages that include base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

 - Salary Range: $200,000 – $300,000 USD
   
   - Note: Final offers are based on experience, specialized skills, interview performance, and relevant training.

 - Equity: Grants are available for eligible roles, subject to board approval.

 - Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Time Off: Flexible time off policies to support work-life balance.
   
   


OUR PROCESS

We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring journey is designed to help both sides align on fit, working style, and expectations.



Reapplication Policy: To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Simi




COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Equal Opportunity: Simile is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, valuing an environment where everyone can contribute authentically.

jobs.jd:
ABOUT TURN/RIVER

Turn/River Capital is a private equity firm that partners with software businesses to drive AI transformation and catalyze capital-efficient growth. As a team of equal parts software operators and investors, we have the people, data-driven playbooks and flexible capital to re-architect engineering, product, go-to-market, talent and resourcing to build enduring value. Founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, Turn/River has $5.6bn in committed capital and invests globally with a focus on North America and Europe.



About the Role

You will be the analytical partner for one of our portfolio companies. Investment and Operating Leads will bring you their hardest revenue questions: why retention moved, where new customer revenue actually comes from, which pricing change is worth making. Those questions often arrive half-formed. Your job is to find the real question, get the data, build the analysis, and deliver a recommendation that holds up in front of our Ops and Investment teams, a portfolio company CEO, or firm leadership. You will sit in a pod with a Data Analytics Lead who owns the portfolio company relationship and a platform team that builds the data pipes. You own the analysis, the dashboards, the recommendation, and its revenue impact.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own value-creation analysis for your portfolio company: retention and cohorts, pricing and packaging, pipeline and funnel yield, and revenue source mapping.

 - Build from raw data, not someone else’s summary. Pull and check the numbers yourself in SQL, our BI tools, and our AI agents.

 - Use AI to compress your cycle time, and flag what should be automated for everyone.

 - Turn findings into recommendations with a quantified revenue impact, a clear owner, and a next step.

 - Support new deals and add-ons when the deal team needs speed.

 - Turn any analysis that gets requested twice into a reusable template or tool for the portfolio and the whole Ops team.



Qualifications

 - 2-4 years of experience in SaaS FP&A or strategic finance, technology investment banking, or strategy consulting with software clients.

 - Command of SaaS economics: ARR bridges, gross and net retention, cohorts, pricing, and unit economics.

 - Experience building models from scratch and producing output that executives can use without rework.

 - Proficiency in SQL and comfort in messy, raw data; demonstrated ability to use AI tools or automation, ideally without being asked.

 - Structured thinker who can break complex revenue processes into systems of components, root causes, and dependencies.

 - Hands-on, execution-oriented, and accountable for results—this is a building role, not an advisory one.

 - Curious, experimental operator who takes feedback well and continuously tests new approaches and technologies

 - Experience owning a relationship with a CFO, CRO, or business unit leader is preferred



Location

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
ABOUT DAVID AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

 

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

 

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.



ABOUT OUR DATA SCIENCE TEAM

Our Data Science team turns the activity across our business into the insights, metrics, and data foundations that guide how we grow. We move fast, own our work end-to-end, and partner closely with product, engineering, research, operations, and go-to-market to make sure the company is working on the right problems, measuring what matters, and drawing data backed conclusions.







ABOUT THIS ROLE

As a Data Scientist at David AI, you'll turn our data into decisions. You'll help figure out what we should be building, measure whether it's working, and lay the foundation for how the company defines, stores, and trusts its data.







IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Work cross-functionally to identify the highest-leverage business problems and drive them to resolution.

 - Form and advocate your own point of view on what you and the broader team should prioritize, using data to shape the roadmap.

 - Define core metrics that measure the health of our business, products, and operations, and own the data dictionary that keeps them consistent across the company.

 - Own A/B experimentation end-to-end, from hypothesis and test design to analysis and ship decision.

 - Design and build reliable ETL pipelines and data models that make our data trustworthy, well-documented, and easy to use.

 - Work across the full range of data science, including experimentation, deep-dive analysis, forecasting, dashboards, and modeling.







YOUR BACKGROUND LOOKS LIKE

 - 3+ years of experience working on a cross-functional team as a product Data Scientist.

 - Experience turning ambiguous problems into clear recommendations.

 - Experience working in a fast paced environment where you owned your work end-to-end.

 - Proficiency with AI coding tools and agentic workflows, grounded in the SQL and Python skills needed to validate their output.
   
   




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining ETL pipelines and data models (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Dagster).

 - Experience defining company-wide metrics, building a data dictionary, or setting up analytics governance.

 - Experience with audio data, data research companies, or LALM evaluations.


VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

jobs.jd:
ABOUT SOLACE

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-10/vcs-give-solace-health-1-billion-valuation-for-patient-advocacy-tech?accessToken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzb3VyY2UiOiJTdWJzY3JpYmVyR2lmdGVkQXJ0aWNsZSIsImlhdCI6MTc3MDczMDg4MywiZXhwIjoxNzcxMzM1NjgzLCJhcnRpY2xlSWQiOiJUQThVUzhLR0NURzEwMCIsImJjb25uZWN0SWQiOiJBRDYxODI0MTc0ODM0MTk0QTRENUZFNzkwMzNGMDJGNSJ9.TE2pFUAOQAPMUXFlzoQ7zeJvctq7cSibbZqtIwhW-2U&leadSource=uverify+wall.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats.

The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making.

In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality.

 - Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy.

 - Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes.

 - Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions.

 - Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure.

 - Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting).

 - Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code.

 - Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing).

 - Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you.

 - Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields.

 - Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis.

 - Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done.


BONUS POINTS

 - Deployment Experience: Experience using tools like Docker, Airflow, or MLflow to deploy and monitor models in production.

 - Healthcare Experience: Experience working with healthcare or insurance claims data is a plus.

 - NLP & Unstructured Data: Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to extract insights from unstructured text data.

 - Marketplace Matching: Experience designing matching algorithms or ranking systems for two-sided marketplaces.

 - dbt & Engineering Skills: Comfort reading or writing dbt models to understand the lineage of your data.

Applicants must be based in the United States.



Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.jd: Data Scientist Build AI That Accelerates Scientific Discovery Do you want your work to help researchers solve humanity’s biggest challenges? At Elsevier, data science is not about building models for the sake of building models. It is about advancing scientific discovery, improving healthcare outcomes, and helping researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions unlock knowledge that can improve lives around the world. Every day, millions of scientists rely on our products to discover evidence, connect ideas, validate findings, and advance research. As a Data Scientist, your work will directly contribute to the tools and technologies that help accelerate human progress. About the Team As part of a growing team of Data Scientists, you will take on some of the hardest problems in science. This team is building intelligent systems that can reason across scientific publications, research data, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, taxonomies, citations, and content spanning every scientific discipline. About the Role As a Data Scientist at Elsevier, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that power knowledge discovery across the global research ecosystem. You will work with one of the world's richest collections of scientific information, including publications, citations, research datasets, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multidisciplinary content spanning every scientific field. This role combines cutting-edge AI with meaningful impact. You will help build intelligent systems that make scientific knowledge more discoverable, trustworthy, connected, and actionable. What You'll Do Design and deploy machine learning, NLP, and generative AI solutions that help researchers discover, understand, and apply scientific knowledge. Build intelligent retrieval, search, recommendation, ranking, and question-answering systems that improve research outcomes. Develop AI systems that connect information across publications, datasets, citations, knowledge graphs, and scientific ontologies. Fine-tune, evaluate, and integrate large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems into production environments. Create robust evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, relevance, trustworthiness, and user impact. Build scalable data pipelines and machine learning workflows that support experimentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Apply the appropriate combination of classical machine learning, deep learning, retrieval, and generative AI techniques to solve complex scientific problems. Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, analytics, and domain experts to transform ambiguous challenges into practical solutions. Contribute clean, maintainable, production-quality Python code and reusable AI components. Continuously improve the capabilities, performance, and real-world value of AI systems that support scientific discovery. What We're Looking For Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Extensive Python programming skills and experience building production-quality data science solutions. Experience with machine learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, feature engineering, and performance optimization. Experience working with large-scale structured, semi-structured, or unstructured datasets. Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and generative AI. Familiarity with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools. Experience evaluating AI outputs and improving model quality, reliability, and business impact. Ability to translate complex problems into measurable, data-driven solutions. A genuine passion for advancing science, improving access to knowledge, and using AI to create meaningful real-world impact. Why Join Elsevier Because your work will matter. You will help build AI systems that support researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, and institutions around the world. Your contributions will help people discover critical evidence, uncover new insights, accelerate innovation, and advance scientific progress. jobs.jd: Data Scientist Build AI That Accelerates Scientific Discovery Do you want your work to help researchers solve humanity’s biggest challenges? At Elsevier, data science is not about building models for the sake of building models. It is about advancing scientific discovery, improving healthcare outcomes, and helping researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions unlock knowledge that can improve lives around the world. Every day, millions of scientists rely on our products to discover evidence, connect ideas, validate findings, and advance research. As a Data Scientist, your work will directly contribute to the tools and technologies that help accelerate human progress. About the Team As part of a growing team of Data Scientists, you will take on some of the hardest problems in science. This team is building intelligent systems that can reason across scientific publications, research data, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, taxonomies, citations, and content spanning every scientific discipline. About the Role As a Data Scientist at Elsevier, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that power knowledge discovery across the global research ecosystem. You will work with one of the world's richest collections of scientific information, including publications, citations, research datasets, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multidisciplinary content spanning every scientific field. This role combines cutting-edge AI with meaningful impact. You will help build intelligent systems that make scientific knowledge more discoverable, trustworthy, connected, and actionable. What You'll Do Design and deploy machine learning, NLP, and generative AI solutions that help researchers discover, understand, and apply scientific knowledge. Build intelligent retrieval, search, recommendation, ranking, and question-answering systems that improve research outcomes. Develop AI systems that connect information across publications, datasets, citations, knowledge graphs, and scientific ontologies. Fine-tune, evaluate, and integrate large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems into production environments. Create robust evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, relevance, trustworthiness, and user impact. Build scalable data pipelines and machine learning workflows that support experimentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Apply the appropriate combination of classical machine learning, deep learning, retrieval, and generative AI techniques to solve complex scientific problems. Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, analytics, and domain experts to transform ambiguous challenges into practical solutions. Contribute clean, maintainable, production-quality Python code and reusable AI components. Continuously improve the capabilities, performance, and real-world value of AI systems that support scientific discovery. What We're Looking For Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Extensive Python programming skills and experience building production-quality data science solutions. Experience with machine learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, feature engineering, and performance optimization. Experience working with large-scale structured, semi-structured, or unstructured datasets. Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and generative AI. Familiarity with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools. Experience evaluating AI outputs and improving model quality, reliability, and business impact. Ability to translate complex problems into measurable, data-driven solutions. A genuine passion for advancing science, improving access to knowledge, and using AI to create meaningful real-world impact. Why Join Elsevier Because your work will matter. You will help build AI systems that support researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, and institutions around the world. Your contributions will help people discover critical evidence, uncover new insights, accelerate innovation, and advance scientific progress. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and meaningful AI problems anywhere—combining world-class data, cutting-edge technology, and a mission dedicated to improving lives through science and knowledge. jobs.title: Regulatory Reporting Analyst

The Analyst uses knowledge of business processes, systems, and databases to improve the overall success of the regulatory reporting function by improving data quality and increasing scalability. In collaboration with the Data and Analytics team, the Analyst defines new data requirements and specifications, and ensures frameworks for data reporting meet the needs of the regulatory reporting department. Define data requirements for regulatory reporting and work in partnership with the Actuarial Data Team to ensure the availability of adequate data resources to accomplish tasks. Work with business process owners to understand and troubleshoot impacts to regulatory data reporting, and recommend solutions. Act as subject matter expert in moderate scale solution development. Perform data scrubbing, aggregation, grouping, and amendment as needed to meet customer requirements. Create and maintain technical documentation of processes and workflows, including purpose, data sources, methodology, procedures for updating, intended use, schedules, and quality control items.
